description: Protocol schema for all required technical checks that must be executed on the study commit (the commit used to run F6 study sessions, task 6.3.1) on reference hardware RHW-001. No measurements are taken here — all statuses are PENDING_EXECUTION until the study commit is known and hardware execution occurs.

dependency_chain.description: These checks MUST be run on the SAME commit used for study sessions (task 6.3.1). Running technical checks on a different commit breaks the evidence chain: the GO/NO-GO decision requires that the performance, accessibility, and regression evidence corresponds to the exact code participants used.
dependency_chain.required_commit_source: The study commit SHA recorded in the study session logs produced by task 6.3.1. All checks below are blocked until that commit is identified and tagged.

ordering.description: Complete study sessions and record the study commit SHA in the session logs.
ordering.produces: study_commit_sha — the Git commit hash of the build used in all study sessions

ordering.description: Confirm study commit integrity: verify the build artifact checksums against the commit SHA before running technical checks.
ordering.produces: build_artifact_checksums — confirms the binary under test matches the study sessions

ordering.description: Execute all technical checks in this file on RHW-001 against the study commit. Each check must record the commit SHA and build artifact checksum it was run against.
ordering.produces: All check result artifacts listed in this file

dependency_chain.violation_condition: Running any technical check below against a commit or build other than the study commit identified in step 1 is a protocol violation. The evidence would not correspond to the code participants actually used and the GO/NO-GO decision would be invalid.
dependency_chain.hardware_constraint: All checks must be run on RHW-001 (reference hardware as defined in task 0.5.1 baseline). Results from other hardware are informational only and do not affect GO.

conjunctive_rule.statement: All 9 checks below are required for GO. A FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, or PENDING_EXECUTION result on any single check at GO decision time is a NO-GO.
conjunctive_rule.missing_data_rule: INCONCLUSIVE is treated as FAIL for GO purposes.
conjunctive_rule.degradation_override: Any degradation of an existing F5 baseline metric is a NO-GO regardless of threshold margin.

checks.name: All new dependencies have approved FOSS dispositions and Supply Chain sign-off

threshold.method: Generate SBOM for F6 3D-spike build; diff against F5 release SBOM closure (evidence/F5/run-001/supply-chain/)
threshold.scope: All new dependencies (Rust crates, npm packages, Python packages, system libraries, WASM modules, bundled assets) in F6 closure absent from F5 closure
required_fields_per_new_dependency: name: exact package/crate/module name and version
license: exact SPDX license identifier (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0) — inferred or assumed licenses not accepted
source_url: canonical repository or package registry URL
checksum: SHA-256 or equivalent cryptographic hash of the artifact as downloaded
foss_disposition: one of [approved, rejected, pending] — must be 'approved' for GO
reviewer: identity of the person who reviewed and approved the disposition
review_timestamp: UTC timestamp of the review
threshold.pass_value: Every new dependency has recorded license, source URL, checksum, and foss_disposition = 'approved'. Supply Chain review sign-off recorded in F6 evidence manifest.
threshold.supply_chain_signoff: Must be a recorded entry in the F6 evidence manifest with reviewer identity, reviewed artifact hash, and UTC timestamp. Self-review by owner/developer is accepted per dev-context.md single-developer pre-production context, but must be explicitly recorded as a separate step.

f5_known_versions.note: Any version bumps to three, @types/three, ngraph.forcelayout, ngraph.graph introduced by F6 spike must be listed in the diff and approved

fail_conditions: Any new dependency has unknown, unrecorded, or unresolved license
Any new dependency has proprietary, non-FOSS, or project-incompatible license
Any new dependency is missing a checksum
Any new dependency has foss_disposition = 'pending' or 'rejected' at GO decision time
